text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council approve a parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Glenmount Avenue, between Lawrence Avenue West and Fairholme Avenue. The proposed parking prohibition will discourage drivers from parking on the street which sometimes causes a back-up of southbound traffic into the intersection of Glenmount Avenue and Lawrence Avenue West.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized a parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Glenmount Avenue, between Lawrence Avenue West and Fairholme Avenue.
